questions.question: 40 men can complete a work in 15 days. Five days after they started working, 10 more men joined them. In how many days will the total work be completed?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

40 men can complete a work in 15 days

After 5 days 10 more men joined 

**FORMULA USED:**

Total work = No. of men × No. of days 

**CALCULATION:**

One man can do the work in = 40 × 15 = 600 days

One - day work of one man = 1/600 

One- day work of men = ( 1/600 ) × 40 = 1/15 

Now, work done in 5 days = ( 1/15 ) × 5 = 1/3 

Work left = 1 - 1/3 = 2/3 

One- day of work of 50 men = ( 1/600) × 50 = 1/12

Time taken to complete the remaining work = (2/3) × (12/1 ) = 8 days 

Total work done in ( 5 + 8 ) = 13 days.

Hence, number of days taken to complete the total work is 13 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** **Formula Used:**

Men × Days = Men × Days

**Calculation:**

40 men can complete a work in 15 days, 

⇒ Hence the total work will be done = 40 × 15

After 5 days, 

⇒ The work will be done = 40 × 10

Now the work 10 more men joined 

Work done,

⇒ 40 × 10 = 50 × Days

⇒ Days = 8

Hence total number of days = 8 + 5 = 13 days.

questions.question: Raj can build a house in 16 days by himself, while Suraj can do it in 12 days. Raj and Suraj work on alternate days. How many days would the house take to build if Raj starts working on the first day?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Raj can build a house = in 16 days

Suraj can build a house = in 12 days 

**Formula used:**

Efficiency = Total unit / No. of days

**Calculation:**

Let the total unit of work be L.C.M of 16 and 12 48 unit

( you can assume any number but for the sake of calculation, it is advised to take L.C.M of the given numbers) 

Now, Efficiency of Raj = Raj 1 day work = 48/16 = 3 

Also, Efficiency of Suraj = Suraj 1 day work = 48/12 = 4 

⇒ 2 days work of Raj and Suraj = 3 + 4 = 7 

Now in 6 pairs of days, they will do = 7 × 6 unit 

⇒ 12 days of work = 42 unit 

⇒ Remaining work = (48 - 42) = 6 unit 

As Raj works 1st. So, on the 13th day, 3 more units of work will be done by him 

Now, only ( 6 - 3 ) = 3 unit work is to be done, which will be done by Suraj, as they work alternatively 

⇒ 14th day work = 3/4 work is done . So, it takes 13 3/4 days to complete the whole work 

**Hence, the house would take 13 3/4 days to be built.**

questions.question: A shopkeeper purchases supplies from a supplier. The supplier sells 750 units of bags to the shopkeeper after gaining the sale price of 125 units of bags. What is the gain percentage of the supplier?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

No. of units bags supplied by supplier = 750 

Gain of units of bags = 125 units

**Formula used:**

Gain = S.P. - C.P. 

Gain % = ( Gain/C.P. ) × 100 

S.P. = Selling Price

C.P. = Cost price 

**Calculation:**

Let the price of 1 unit of bag = Rs.1

S.P. of supplier = 750 units = Rs.750 

Gain of supplier = 125 units = Rs.125

⇒ Gain = C.P. - S.P. 

⇒ 125 = C.P. - 750 

⇒ C.P. = Rs.625.

⇒ Gain% = ( Gain/C.P. ) × 100 

⇒ (125/ 625) × 100

⇒ 20 

**∴ Gain% of supplier is 20%.**

questions.question: In a ∆ ABC, a line DE is drawn from D point on AB to E point on AC such that DE is parallel to BC. Also AD ∶ DB is 2 ∶ 5. If AC is 4.2 cm, then what is the length of AE?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A triangle ABC 

DE is parallel to BC 

AD : DB = 2 :5 

AC = 4.2 cm 

**CONCEPT USED:**

Mid point theorem : The line segment joining the mid points of any two sides of a triangle

is parallel to the third side.

**CALCULATION:**

** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d953a99800195c2f75005d7aaad63b3f5cda1be4e18110b51245467b86bb3313.png] 

Here, we have a triangle ABC 

 DE is parallel to BC and D and E are the mid points of AB and AC respectively, we have 

 AD = DB and AE = EC 

 We have AD/DB = 2/5 and AC = 4.2 cm 

 So, according to the mid point theorem ,

⇒ AD/( AD + DB) = AE /( AE + EC) = AD/AB = AE/AC 

⇒ 2/7 = AE / 4.2

⇒ AE = 2/7 × 4.2 = 1.2 

**Hence, the value of AE is 1.2 cm.**

questions.question: When 44 is subtracted from a number; it reduces to its 60%. Three-fifth of that number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A number reduces to 60% when 44 is subtracted 

**Calculation:**

Let the required number be x 

⇒ x - 44 = x × 60/100 

⇒ x - 44 = 3x/5 

⇒ x - 3x/5 = 44 

⇒ 2x/5 = 44 

⇒ x = 110.

⇒ 3/5th of number = 3/5 × 110

⇒ 66.

**∴ three-fifth of the number is 66.**

questions.question: When a number is divided by 296, the remainder is 75. What will be the remainder when the same number is divided by 37?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

When a number is divided by 296, the remainder is 75 

**FORMULA USED:**

Dividend = D × Q + R 

Where, D = Divisor , Q = Quotient , R = Remainder 

**CALCULATION:**

Let the number ( Dividend) be x 

⇒ x = 296 × Q + 75 

Where Q is quotient and can have any value 1, 2 , 3 etc. 

⇒ x = 37 × 8 × Q + 37 × 2 + 1 = 37 ( 8Q + 2) + 1 

so, the remainder is 1 

**Hence, when number is divided by 37 its remainder is 1.**

questions.question: The average of 10 numbers is 47. What should be the 11th number added to them to make the average 53?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Average of 10 numbers is 47 

**FORMULA USED:**

Average = Sum of values/ No. of values

**CALCULATION:**

Here, the average of 10 numbers = 47 

⇒ Average = Sum of values/ No. of values 

⇒ 47 = Sum of values / 10 

⇒ Sum of the numbers = 470.

Now, as the new average given is 53 and the total number now is 11.

⇒ Sum of the new numbers = Average × No. of values = 53 × 11 = 583 .

Now, the number to be added to make the average 53 = ( 583 - 470) = 113.

**Hence, the required number to be added is 113.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Difference (New average - Old average) = 53 - 47 = 6,

 

11th number = average + D × total number = 47 + 6 × 11 =113

questions.question: Anil deposited Rs. 8,000 in a two-year fixed deposit scheme on compound interest compounded annually at 5% per annum. Find the maturity value of the fixed deposit.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Principal is Rs8,000

Rate = 5%

**FORMULA USED:**

A = P × ( 1 + R/100)t 

Where, A = Amount, P = Principal , R = Rate of interest t = time in years

**CALCULATION:**

Here, we have A = Rs8,000, Time = 2 years, Rate = 5% 

⇒ A = P × ( 1 + R/100)t 

⇒ A = 8,000 × ( 1 + 5/100)² = 8,000 × 21/20 × 21/20 

⇒ A = 8,820.

**Hence, the maturity value of fixed deposit is Rs8,820.**

questions.question: A businessman marks up the price of his goods by 25% and gives a discount of 5% to the customer. He also uses a 950 gm weight instead of a 1000 gm weight. Find his overall profit percentage.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the Successive Ratio Method (CP : SP):

Markup of 25% ⇒ 4 : 5

Discount of 5% ⇒ 20 : 19

False weight (950g instead of 1000g) ⇒ 950 : 1000 = 19 : 20

Overall Ratio (CP : SP) = (4 × 20 × 19) : (5 × 19 × 20) = 4 : 5

Overall Profit % = (1 ÷ 4) × 100 = 25%

**∴ The correct answer is 25%.**

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 72?
questions.solution:
**CONCEPT USED:**

Divisibility rule of 8 & 9

**CALCULATION:**

⇒ 72 = 8× 9

⇒ 8 and 9 are the factors of 72

In considering option ( 1 ), we have 

⇒ 23724128

By applying the divisibility rule of 8 

⇒ 128/8 = 16

Here last 3 digits get divided by 8

So, 23724128, is divisible by 8

Now, check the divisibility rule of 9

⇒ ( 2 + 3 + 7 + 2 + 4 + 1 + 2 + 8 ) = 29

⇒ 29 is not divisible by 9

Hence, 23724128 is not divisible by 9 

So, 23724128 is not divisible by 72.

**In considering option ( 2 ), we have **

⇒ 24127812

By applying the divisibility rule of 8

⇒ 812/8 is not divisible by 8

Here, 24127812 is also not divisible by 8 

So, 24127812 is not divisible by 72.

**In considering option ( 3 ), we have **

⇒ 35127918

By applying the divisibility rule of 8

⇒ 918/8 is not divisible by 8.

Here, 35127918 is also not divisible by 8

So, 35127918 is also not divisible by 72.

**On considering option ( 4 ), we get**

⇒ 22112136

By applying the divisibility rule of 8

⇒ 136/8 = 17

These last 3 digits get divided by 8

So, 22112136 is also divided by 8

By checking the divisibility rule of 9 

⇒ ( 2 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 3 + 6 ) = 18

⇒ 18 is completely divided by 9.

Here, the number is divided by both 8 and 9

So, it is divided by 72 as well.

**∴ The number 22112136 is divided by 72.**

questions.question: A man’s average driving speed for 9 hours is 72 km/h. During the first 3 hours of his journey, he drove at 54 km/h, and for the next 2 hours and 15 minutes, he drove at a speed of 68 km/h. He maintained a speed of 90 km/h for another 3 hours. What was his speed (in km/h) for the last 45 minutes?
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A man's driving speed for 9 hours is 72 km/h 

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**CALCULATION:**

 Total distance to be covered by man = 9 × 72 = 648 km

 Distance covered in first 3 hours at speed of 54 km/h = 3 × 54 = 162 km

 Distance covered in 2 hours and 15 minutes at 68 km/h = 2 +( 15/60 ) × 68 = 9/4 × 68 = 153 km ( As 1hour =60 min)

 Distance covered in 3 hours at 90 km/ h = 3 × 90 = 270 km 

 Remaining distance = 648 - ( 162 + 153 + 270) = 648 - 585 = 63km

Now, speed to cover 63 km in last 45 minutes 

⇒Speed = 63/ (45/60) = 63 × 60 /45 = 84 km/h ( As 60 min = 1 hour , so 45 min = 45/ 60 h)

**Hence, the required speed is 84 km/h.**

questions.question: If O is the orthocentre of a ∆ ABC and ∠BOC = 140°, then the measure of ∠BAC is:
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

A triangle ABC and O is orthocentre 

angle BOC = 140^circ 

**CONCEPT USED:**

Sum of all the angles in quadrilateral = 360 degree

Orthocentre : It is the point where the perpendicular drawn from the vertices to the opposite

sides of the triangle intersect each other 

**CALCULATION:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb8937eb80be8b7f5f2606b5d21f2f53beb92ffca5530c49391dc12aa0b6ecb5.png] 

If in triangle ABC, BE and CD are altitudes and they intersect at O then,

 angleODA = angleOEA = 90 and angleBOC = angleDOE = 140 

 In quadrilateral ADOE 

⇒ angle ADO + angleDOE + angleOEA + angleDAE = 360 

⇒ 90 + 140 + 90 + angle DAE = 360 

⇒ angleDAE = 360 - ( 90 + 140 + 90) = 360 - 320 = 40 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] 

__Shortcut Trick__**

 angleBOC + angleBAC = 180 

⇒ angleBAC = 180 - 140 = 40 

**Hence, the required angle is 40 degree.**

questions.question: Determine the list price of an item if a 20% discount on the item amounts to Rs. 50.
questions.solution:
**GIVEN:**

Discount% = 20 

Discount = Rs50 

**FORMULA USED:**

Discount% = (Discount/M.P.) × 100 

Where, M.P. = Marked Price or list price 

**CALCULATION:**

Here, we have discount = Rs50 and discount% = 20 

⇒ Discount% = ( Discount/M.P.) × 100 

⇒ 20 = ( 50/M.P.) × 100 

⇒ M.P. = 250.

**Hence, list price of an item is Rs250.**
